caption:
What's your cheap rescue dinner? Tell us in the comments.

End of the month? In WE.LIFE the “On a budget” button shows your shopping budget and prices in one place. You see the cost before you shop and fit your meal plan to your budget.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.

Images in this video are AI-generated illustrations.

#budgetmeals #savemoney #mealplan
